hooks.name: Format, Lint & Type-check on Save
hooks.description: Runs scaffolded formatter, linter, and type-check commands after a TypeScript or Python file is saved (Kiro University Lesson 3, Hook A).

action.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'; function Invoke-Checked { param([scriptblock]$Command) & $Command; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru\frontend'); Invoke-Checked { npm run format:check }; Invoke-Checked { npm run lint }; Invoke-Checked { npm run typecheck }; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru\backend'); Invoke-Checked { python -m black --check app tests }; Invoke-Checked { python -m ruff check app tests }; Invoke-Checked { python -m mypy }; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru\infra'); Invoke-Checked { python -m black --check app.py namma_ooru_infra tests }; Invoke-Checked { python -m ruff check app.py namma_ooru_infra tests }; Invoke-Checked { python -m mypy }
